entries: Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin

Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one
Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded
Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged
Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans
Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as `../../…`; they now show `~/…` or the full path
Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions
Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal
Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK is set on a paid plan
Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions
Fixed `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field
Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout
Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as ~/.zshrc
Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error
Fixed `/privacy-settings` offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error
Fixed a "Context limit reached" or "Prompt is too long" error after stopping a turn while Claude Code was compacting a conversation the API had rejected as too long
Fixed subagents sometimes forgetting their most recent work when they were messaged or resumed right after finishing
Fixed `claude --help` text for `--tools`, `--resume`, `--debug`, `--json-schema`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--system-prompt-snapshot` and `claude update` to match actual behavior
Fixed `claude --worktree` removing the worktree and its branch without asking at exit when HEAD was detached or on another branch, which could lose commits
Fixed resumed and cloud sessions sending Claude the whole skill list again each time plugins reloaded at startup
Fixed an interrupt not ending a Read that waits on an idle pipe or device named like an image
Fixed `/effort status`, `/effort ultracode` and the prompt's effort indicator showing a guessed effort level when `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` is `auto` or `unset` and no level is sent
Fixed a PreToolUse hook's deny reason being replaced by a timeout error when an Agent SDK callback hook on the same tool call timed out

title.zh-TW: 自動模式新增引導設定，工作階段記錄不再重複堆積分類脈絡
title.en: Auto Mode Adds Guided Setup, and Session Logs Stop Accumulating Classifier Context

body.zh-TW: 若想放手讓 Claude 自動執行任務，卻擔心它摸不清專案架構，現在有新工具能先幫它建立背景認知。輸入 `/auto-mode-setup` 指令，能讀取當前專案與近期工作階段（session，對話互動的生命週期），引導你教導自動模式熟悉執行環境。這項功能也支援 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、Claude 應用閘道，以及停用遙測的工作階段。在自動模式運作時，安全分類器的上下文不再隨每次請求反覆寫入，有效縮減了記錄檔體積。⟦像新進助理報到時先詳讀交接手冊，之後每次跑公文就不必把厚厚整本規章重複釘在每張簽呈後面。⟧
body.en: If you want to let Claude execute tasks automatically but worry it will not understand your project architecture, a new tool can now help build its background context first. Running the `/auto-mode-setup` command reads your current project and recent sessions (the lifecycle of a conversational interaction), guiding you through teaching auto mode about your execution environment. This feature also supports Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude app gateways, and sessions with telemetry disabled. While auto mode is running, safety classifier context is no longer rewritten with every request, significantly reducing log file size. ⟦Think of a new assistant reading a handover manual thoroughly upon onboarding; subsequent paperwork no longer requires stapling the thick rulebook behind every single sign-off sheet.⟧

items.original:
Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
Improved session file size in auto mode: the safety classifier's context is no longer stored with every request

title.zh-TW: `/claude-api` 新增代理人安全比對，AWS 環境優先使用專屬命令列
title.en: `/claude-api` Adds Agent Security Verification and Prioritizes Dedicated CLI on AWS

body.zh-TW: 在雲端管理自主代理人時，往往需要確認現有配置是否符合官方的安全規範。現在輸入 `/claude-api managed-agents-secure` 指令，能直接將託管代理人的設定與 Anthropic 公布的安全指南逐項對照，過程中完全不改動任何現有設定。在 AWS 平台的 Claude Platform 環境中，`/claude-api` 技能也會直接調用 `ant` 命令列工具，不再退回使用軟體套件或傳輸指令。⟦好比拿著官方消防清單巡視機房，逐條核對逃生門與滅火設備卻不任意更動擺設，通報時也直接使用專線對講機。⟧
body.en: When managing autonomous agents in the cloud, you often need to confirm whether current configurations comply with official security standards. Running `/claude-api managed-agents-secure` now audits managed agent settings item by item against Anthropic's published security guidelines without modifying any existing configuration. In Claude Platform environments on AWS, the `/claude-api` skill directly invokes the `ant` command-line tool instead of falling back to software packages or transfer commands. ⟦An inspector tours a server room with an official fire safety checklist, checking fire exits and extinguishers item by item without moving any equipment, and reporting updates directly over a dedicated radio.⟧

title.zh-TW: 成品支援各分頁獨立連結，刪除確認改用數字鍵防誤按
title.en: Artifacts Support Independent Tab Links, and Deletion Confirmations Use Number Keys to Prevent Accidents

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 產出包含多種檢視的成品時，常需要精準掌握各個畫面的位置與連結。現在索取成品連結時，Claude 會明確列出每個分頁檢視的完整連結，並特別提醒切換不同視圖時瀏覽器網址列不會改變。使用 `/artifacts` 刪除成品時，確認提示改為編號選單：按 1 或 Enter 會保留成品，按 2 則確定刪除，原本熟悉的 y、n 與 Esc 鍵也依然相容。⟦如同翻閱附有各章節書籤的展覽手冊，內頁清楚標明每個展示廳的對應代碼，撕下頁面時還需核對號碼牌防範失誤。⟧
body.en: When asking Claude to produce artifacts containing multiple views, you often need precise control over the location and link for each screen. Requesting artifact links now prompts Claude to explicitly list full URLs for every tab view, while noting that switching views will not update the browser address bar. When deleting artifacts via `/artifacts`, the confirmation prompt now uses a numbered menu: pressing 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, while pressing 2 confirms deletion, with familiar y, n, and Esc keys remaining compatible. ⟦Flipping through an exhibition guide with bookmarked sections reveals the exact code for each display hall, while tearing out a page requires matching a numbered stub to prevent mistakes.⟧

items.original:
Improved artifacts with several views: when you ask for links to them, Claude now writes out each view's link and explains that the address bar stays the same as you switch views
Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to show numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, 2 deletes it, and y, n and Esc still work

title.zh-TW: 恢復長對話前提示用量佔比，用量查詢明確標示冷卻結束時間
title.en: Resume Prompts Warn of Usage Impact on Long Conversations, and Usage Queries Display Cooldown End Times

body.zh-TW: 打算接續過往暫停的冗長對話時，往往難以拿捏載入歷史脈絡會吃掉多少配額。Pro 與 Max 方案現在新增用量警示：當恢復非活躍對話會佔用 5 小時用量上限的顯著比例時，終端機會跳出確認提示。你可以選擇直接恢復，或者開啟乾淨的新對話，後續只要提及前次內容，Claude 就會主動回頭查閱。查詢 `/usage` 遇到資料頻率限制時，介面會清楚列出限制結束的時間點；Opus 5.5 在 `/fast` 視窗標題中的研究預覽標籤也已正式移除。⟦彷彿重新發動車輛前儀表板先提醒這段路將耗損多數油料，油槍跳停時也會亮出倒數計時告示。⟧
body.en: When planning to resume a lengthy paused conversation, it is often hard to gauge how much quota loading historical context will consume. Pro and Max plans now introduce a usage warning: if resuming an inactive conversation would take up a significant share of your 5-hour limit, the terminal displays a confirmation prompt. You can choose to resume directly or start a clean new conversation, after which Claude will proactively look back whenever you mention earlier context. When checking `/usage` hits a data rate limit, the interface clearly shows when the restriction ends; Opus 5.5's research preview label in the `/fast` window title has also been officially removed. ⟦Before restarting an engine, the dashboard warns that the planned trip will consume most remaining fuel, and a gas pump displays a countdown timer when it shuts off.⟧

Improved `/usage` to say when a rate limit on usage data ends instead of "try again in a moment"
Removed the "(research preview)" label from the `/fast` dialog title on Opus 5.5

title.zh-TW: 擴充模組支援嚴格人工授權，唯讀判定與設定層級控制更精準
title.en: Extensions Support Strict Human Authorization, with Precise Read-Only Flags and Configuration Tier Control

body.zh-TW: 自己撰寫擴充模組攔截工具呼叫時，最需要掌控敏感操作的授權邊界。模組在 `tool.check` 中新增 `decider: "person"` 屬性，限定只有權限確認對話框或宿主回呼可以核准請求；在無人可詢問的環境下，會依照模組理由直接拒絕。事件參數也新增 `e.isReadOnly` 標記工具是否為唯讀。若有先執行的外掛跳過你的模組掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），記錄檔會明確寫出該外掛與事件名稱。模組的 `settings.read` 掛鉤現已能讀取每一層設定並覆寫合併值，將組織設定設為不可踰越的上限。外掛驗證指令也不再印出猜測掛鉤位置的文字。⟦類似機密門禁安裝雙重防線，危險操作非得由保全人員親自核章，各級主管的授權天花板也層層防堵。⟧
body.en: When writing extensions to intercept tool calls, controlling authorization boundaries for sensitive operations is critical. Modules add a `decider: "person"` property to `tool.check`, restricting approvals exclusively to permission confirmation dialogs or host callbacks; without an available human to ask, requests are denied directly with the module's reason. The event parameter also adds `e.isReadOnly` to flag whether a tool is read-only. If an earlier plugin bypasses your module hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), the log explicitly records the plugin and event names. The `settings.read` hook in modules can now read every configuration layer and override merged values, locking organizational settings as an inviolable ceiling. Plugin validation commands also no longer print text guessing hook locations. ⟦A high-security checkpoint deploys dual defense lines, requiring security personnel to stamp dangerous operations in person while executive authorization ceilings block unauthorized escalations.⟧

title.zh-TW: 模組重載失敗不再丟失舊版工具，同名按鈕點擊精準識別
title.en: Module Reload Failures Retain Older Tools, and Clicks on Duplicate Buttons Register Accurately

body.zh-TW: 在對話過程中調整自訂模組時，程式若出現語法錯誤常會打斷原本的工作流程。以前模組重新載入失敗時，會誤把原本正常載入的舊版工具與指令清空；現在載入失敗會完整保留既有版本，終端機也會清楚顯示載入狀態。畫面上標籤相同且未指定 `key` 的多顆按鈕，重新繪製後點擊事件不再無故遺失。在企業或受管制的設備上，`plugin-authoring` 技能分享模組時不會再卡在機密掃描。啟用工作階段中模組的提示改為純文字，換輪時保持可見，啟用當下也會清楚告知載入內容。⟦跟樂團更換曲譜一樣，新譜印錯時樂手繼續照著舊譜演奏而不中斷旋律，按鍵重複時也能確實聽見回饋。⟧
body.en: Adjusting custom modules during a conversation can easily disrupt workflows if a syntax error occurs. Previously, a failed module reload cleared out working older tools and commands by mistake; now, reload failures preserve existing versions intact while the terminal clearly displays reload status. When multiple buttons share identical labels without a specified `key`, click events are no longer lost after rerendering. On enterprise or managed devices, sharing modules via the `plugin-authoring` skill no longer hangs on secrets scanning. Prompts activating in-session modules have switched to plain text, remaining visible across turns and clearly reporting loaded content upon activation. ⟦Much like an orchestra changing sheet music, musicians keep playing from older scores when new prints contain errors without breaking the melody, and duplicate keystrokes still produce clear feedback.⟧

title.zh-TW: 技能重新整理只傳送異動項目，單一來源掛鉤設定數量上限
title.en: Skill Reloads Transmit Only Changes, and Single Sources Face Hook Limits

body.zh-TW: 專案掛載了大量自訂技能時，頻繁更新容易讓對話上下文被重複的說明文字佔滿。以前每次外掛重載都會把整份技能清單重複送出；現在執行 `/reload-skills` 只會傳送新增或異動的項目，對話壓縮後則會確實補送一次最新總表。為避免外掛無限擴充，單一來源在每個工作階段（session，對話互動的生命週期）最多能註冊 1,024 個掛鉤與 16,384 個匹配字元。技能的單次掛鉤觸發後不再誤刪其他技能的同名掛鉤；若政策禁止本機技能掛鉤，該技能也無法取得預設的授權工具。⟦宛如圖書館更新借閱目錄，館方只印出新進書目的補充清單，每個民間贊助單位能擺設的立牌總量也受到限制。⟧
body.en: When a project loads numerous custom skills, frequent updates can easily flood conversation context with redundant descriptions. Previously, every plugin reload resent the entire skill inventory; running `/reload-skills` now transmits only added or modified entries, while conversation compaction reliably resends a fresh full inventory. To prevent plugins from expanding indefinitely, a single source can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matching characters per session (the lifecycle of a conversational interaction). A skill's single-fire hook no longer deletes identical hooks from other skills upon triggering, and skills cannot obtain default authorization tools if policy bans local skill hooks. ⟦Like a library updating its catalog, staff print supplementary slips only for new arrivals, while capping the number of display stands each private sponsor can place.⟧
